title: Senior Engineering Manager
description:
Role - Software Engineering Manager 
 Overview 
 This position is hybrid in Atlanta, Georgia and sits within our Product Development division, which develops, tests, and improves our software solutions in an innovative and collaborative environment.
 The Opportunity 
 The Manager, Software Engineering is a hands-on technical leader responsible for driving innovation, adopting new technologies, and leading change. The ideal candidate demonstrates technical depth and strong architectural understanding, enabling them to coach engineering teams, participate in feasibility discussions, support technical decisions, and is passionate about enabling modern engineering practices, including AI-assisted development. In addition to removing blockers and maximizing team productivity, this leader champions scalable solutions and guides teams through change with empathy and clarity.
 Responsibilities 
 What Youll Be Doing Lead, mentor, and support a distributed team of Software Engineers, developing personalized career paths, and encouraging continuous upskilling including the use of AI-assisted tools for coding, documentation, testing, and code review. Provide strong technical guidance and foster a culture of technical excellence, innovation, and ethical use of AI across the team. Support engineers in maintaining focus and delivering quality outcomes by ensuring they understand clear priorities, allocating resources effectively, and resolving blockers early. Participate in architecture discussions, advocating for scalable, AI-ready systems, and modern development practices. Maintain and evolve a high-performing team culture by hiring top talent and reinforcing our values of excellence, innovation, and continuous improvement. Track, analyze, and report on key engineering performance metrics (e.g., velocity, quality, cycle time), using insights to drive continuous improvement in team effectiveness and delivery outcomes. This job description in no way implies that the duties listed here are the only ones that team members can be required to perform Qualifications 
 What You Bring to the Team BS in Computer Science or a related field, or demonstrable equivalent experience. 8+ years of professional software development experience using technologies such as C#, WPF, Java, Python, and/or JavaScript. 4+ years of leadership experience with a focus on mentorship, career growth, and delivery. Proven ability to mentor engineers and lead technical discussions, from architecture to implementation. Strong grasp of software engineering best practices: Agile workflows, CI/CD, TDD, code reviews, and build/release automation. Experience working with Google Cloud Platform. Familiarity with short release cycles and products in active production use. Deep knowledge of OOP principles, data structures, and algorithms. Demonstrated experience evaluating and integrating AI tools into development workflows, debugging, and CI/CD pipelines. Strong problem-solving, analytical, and communication skills. Committed to sound business ethics and handling of confidential information. Experience working in Product Operating Model is a plus.

Key Skills: Engineering Management,C#,Java,Software Engineering,GCP,Agile,People Management Skills,Python

title: Cloud Native Application Protection
description:
Role : Cloud Native Application Protection (CNAPP) Experience: 7 to 12 Years Location: Pune Notice period: Serving NP/30 Days Shifts : Should be comfortable for rotations must Work model : Should be comfortable for both Hybrid and complete 5 days WFO Job Description We are seeking a skilled and motivated Cloud Security Engineer to join the CTE to support the deployment and operationalisation of a Cloud Native Application Protection (CNAPP) service across multi-cloud environments. You will work closely with software engineers, cloud platform teams, operations to ensure our services meet availability and performance goals. Responsibilities Implement cloud security guard rails using CNAPP tools across multi-cloud environments (AWS, GCP, Azure) to meet security requirements. Implement changes to CNAPP platform using DevOps pipeline and infrastructure as code (Terraform cloud formation etc.) to apply changes. Write script to extract cloud security data point for global reporting e.g. python, Review and assess cloud security findings (permissions, misconfigurations, detections), out of box vendor rules, accuracy of detection and identify false positives to fine tune the solution. Partner with cloud architects, DevOps, IT Service owners, and SOC teams to ensure cloud security controls are met, and support incidents management when required. Requirements Hands on experience with cloud native application security solution and cloud security posture management tools e.g. CrowdStrike, Wiz, Orca, Prisma cloud Cyber security experience with cloud security (AWS, GCP, Azure, AliCloud) risks and controls does a violation present a material risk, why and potential impact. Strong collaboration and stakeholders management Experience in building and deploying applications on the Cloud, using CI/CD frameworks and Infrastructure automation, such as: Jenkins, Terraform, Ansible, GitHub, Nexus and Jenkins. Extensive working knowledge of software development tools and technologies; specifically, Python, Bash, PowerShell, SQL, and data formats such as XML, JSON, CSV Nice to have: CSP security certificate e.g. AWS/GCP/Azure certified security speciality,

title: Cloud Solutions Architect
description:
This role is intended for an experienced Cloud Architect with strong cloud and backend development expertise who enjoys building reliable software systems that integrate with industrial equipment. The Cloud Solutions Architect will implement, deploy, and sustain cloud-connected applications, backend services, software infrastructure, and shared technology platforms supporting NOV's Service Equipment product portfolio. Working closely with engineering leadership and system architects, this individual will translate architectural direction into scalable, production-ready solutions while providing technical mentorship, promoting software engineering best practices, and taking ownership of the reliability, maintainability, and continuous improvement of the software platform. 
 Responsibilities Develop, maintain, and support cloud-based software platforms and backend services supporting NOV Service Equipment products. Design, implement, and maintain AWS infrastructure, deployment pipelines, containerized applications, and production software environments. Collaborate with engineering teams to integrate industrial equipment with cloud services, databases, APIs, and enterprise applications. Troubleshoot complex software, infrastructure, networking, and system integration issues across development and production environments. Establish and promote software engineering best practices including code reviews, testing, documentation, and deployment processes. Mentor software engineers through technical guidance, design reviews, and collaborative problem solving. Develop reusable software frameworks and shared platform capabilities that support multiple product lines. Support software validation, release management, and remote deployment activities for production systems. Take technical ownership of assigned software platforms and proactively identify opportunities to improve reliability, scalability, security, and maintainability. 
 Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering or applicable experience. Minimum of 10 years of professional software engineering experience developing and supporting production software systems. Demonstrated experience designing, deploying, and maintaining cloud-based applications using Amazon Web Services (AWS). Strong experience developing backend software, REST APIs, databases, containerized applications, and modern software development practices. Excellent written and verbal English communication skills with the ability to collaborate effectively in a remote engineering environment. United State travel Visa preferred. 
 Success Factors: Demonstrates technical ownership by taking responsibility for software platforms and driving complex technical issues through resolution. Builds reliable, maintainable, and scalable software systems with a long-term product mindset. Communicates proactively, collaborates effectively across distributed engineering teams, and mentors other engineers through technical leadership. Continuously evaluates opportunities to improve software architecture, development processes, deployment practices, and operational reliability. Approaches technical challenges with curiosity, professionalism, and a commitment to delivering high-quality engineering solutions.

Key Skills: Scalability,AWS Cloud,Reliability,AWS,Rest APIs,Security,API,Cloud
